advertisingOversight.title: Advertising oversight
advertisingOversight.subtitle: Review content, disclosure and spend for sponsored placements. Record manual bank-transfer payments.
advertisingOversight.permissionBody: You do not have permission to oversee advertising.
advertisingOversight.emptyBody: There are no advertising placements in this status.
advertisingOversight.noActions: No actions are available for this status.
advertisingOversight.approveNote: Approval confirms content, disclosure and spend are valid. The placement goes live once paid and the run window opens.
advertisingOversight.reasonHint: The reason is sent to the partner.
advertisingOversight.markPaidNote: Manual / bank-transfer payment. Enter the transaction reference for reconciliation.
advertisingOversight.paymentRefHint: This reference is visible to admins only.
advertisingOversight.disableNote: The placement stops immediately and the sponsored/featured label is removed from the target (unless another placement still covers it).
advertisingOversight.relabelHelp: Only change the label within compliance rules.
advertisingOversight.relabelPaidLockHint: Paid inventory must always show the sponsored label and cannot be relabelled to a curated/partner class.
advertisingOversight.relabelPaidImmutable: A paid placement's disclosure cannot be relabelled to a non-paid class. The sponsored label must always show.
advertisingOversight.missingApprovedBody: These slots have no approved banner yet: {slots}.
advertisingOversight.creativeNoneBody: The partner has not uploaded any banner for this campaign.
advertisingOversight.insightPendingApproval: Campaigns are waiting for approval — review to keep partner campaigns on schedule
advertisingOversight.insightActiveCampaigns: Active campaigns are live — monitor for compliance and performance
advertisingOversight.insightNoActivity: No active or pending campaigns — the advertising queue is quiet
advertisingOversight.insightHighSpend: High active spend volume — ensure payment records are reconciled

campaign.title: Ad campaign review
campaign.subtitle: Review, approve, and oversee budget-based sponsored campaigns competing for marketplace ad slots.
campaign.emptyBody: There are no campaigns in this status.

action.none: No actions available for this status.

campaign.approveNote: An approved campaign serves once its schedule opens. The sponsored label always shows publicly.
campaign.rejectBody: Reject “{name}”? The partner can edit and resubmit.
campaign.reasonHint: The reason is shown to the partner so they can edit and resubmit.
campaign.pauseBody: Pause “{name}”? It stops serving until resumed.
campaign.pauseNote: The campaign can be resumed later by the partner or an admin.
campaign.disableNote: This stops serving immediately. An optional reason note is saved to the moderation log.
campaign.markPaidNote: Enter the transaction reference. This is used only for spend oversight.
campaign.paymentRefHint: Bank transfer reference or invoice number.
campaign.relabelHelp: Only paid inventory carries the non-removable “Sponsored” label. Paid inventory can never be relabelled to a non-paid class.
campaign.relabelImmutable: Paid inventory can't be relabelled to a non-paid class.
campaign.conflictBody: This campaign was updated elsewhere. The queue has been reloaded.
